## berth host add

register a host: pin its SSH key, check Docker, and give berth its own key there

### Synopsis

Connects with your own SSH access (ssh-agent, or --identity), pins the host's key in berth's known_hosts
(asking you to confirm its fingerprint, or taking --fingerprint), checks Docker and compose, then adds a key
of berth's own to the host's authorized_keys and records the host. --home is the state root there
(default ~/.local/share/berth). Nothing on the host is started or restarted.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_host_add/

```
berth host add <name> <[user@]host[:port]> [--home <dir>] [--identity <key file>] [--fingerprint SHA256:…] [--accept-new-host-key] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth host add box1 ops@box1.example
  berth host add box1 box1.example:2222 --fingerprint SHA256:…
```
